To set up MFA on a new phone, follow these steps [1]:

Raise a ticket titled "Reset MFA" so the service desk can clear your old MFA registration [1]
Once the ticket is resolved, install Northwind Authenticator from the App Store or Google Play [1]
Sign in to any work app. When asked, scan the QR code shown on screen with the app [1]
Enter the six-digit code to finish [1]

When you first register, the app will show 8 single-use backup codes—store these in the company password manager, not on paper [2].

Here are the steps to try:

Check your NorthLink version – Make sure you're running version 5.2 or later, as older versions drop connections on weak Wi-Fi [2].

Improve your Wi-Fi signal – Move closer to your router or connect with a network cable instead [2].

Change the protocol – In NorthLink settings, switch from "Auto" to "TCP". This fixes most random disconnects [2].

Note the 12-hour limit – VPN sessions disconnect automatically after 12 hours, and idle sessions disconnect after 60 minutes [4]. You'll need to reconnect and sign in again.

If these steps don't work, open a ticket on the service desk portal and attach the NorthLink log file (Help > Export logs) [1].

Go to the self-service page at reset.northwind.example [1]
Enter your work email and approve the MFA prompt [1]
Choose a new password that meets the policy requirements (at least 14 characters, not reusing any of your last 10 passwords) [1]

If you cannot pass the MFA step, contact the service desk. They will verify your identity with your manager before resetting your password [3]
